info.title: SpendWise API
info.description: Same-origin REST API. Every financial resource belongs to the authenticated user. Money is always a decimal string; dates use YYYY-MM-DD. All unsafe requests require an exact allowed Origin. Cookie-authenticated mutations additionally require X-CSRF-Token. No user_id may be supplied in inputs.
